items.q: How long does the whole process take?
items.a: From the moment you choose a candidate to their arrival in Serbia, it usually takes 30 to 60 days.

items.q: How do I know a candidate is right for the job?
items.a: Partner agencies follow your requirements closely, and we verify CVs, experience and references. You talk to candidates before the final decision.

items.q: What if a worker isn't a fit?
items.a: Within the first 90 days we provide a replacement free of charge.
We do. We apply for the visa and the residence and work permit, and deal with embassies, the Ministry of Interior and the National Employment Service on your behalf.

items.q: What language will the workers speak?
items.a: English at first — it's a selection requirement — and over time they learn Serbian too.

items.q: What does the employer need to provide?
items.a: An employment contract in line with the law, decent accommodation and basic living conditions (including internet). We agree on all the details at the start.

items.q: Which countries do the workers come from?
items.a: Nepal, Indonesia, Uzbekistan, Kenya, the UAE and India — through vetted partner agencies.

items.q: How much does it cost to bring in foreign workers?
items.a: The price depends on the number of workers, the positions and the timeline. Send an enquiry and you'll get an offer tailored to you.
